tintagel_pasty_seller.text: Hot pasties, cold sea air. Tintagel was designed for this.
Beef, potato, swede, onion, crimp on the side. Anything else is just a savoury pie.
Folk used to shout 'Oggy oggy oggy' to miners underground. Oggy is slang for pasty. The miners shouted back.

then.text: I only have one for you, sorry. Customers are queuing and the gulls are queuing too.

else.text: Take one for the cliff path. Eat it somewhere windy.
